combat.name: Ceremonial Bladework
combat.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

combat.name: Frostgnaw
combat.descriptionRaw: Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya.\n\nKaeya seems affable, but his nature is that of unyielding ice.
combat.description:
Unleashes a frigid blast, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in front of Kaeya.

Kaeya seems affable, but his nature is that of unyielding ice.

combat.name: Glacial Waltz
combat.descriptionRaw: Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him. These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration. A winsome smile, genial words, and the merciless hoarfrost that lies beneath... These are all Kaeya's weapons.
combat.description:
Coalescing the frost in the air, Kaeya summons 3 icicles that revolve around him.
These icicles will follow the character around and deal Cryo DMG to opponents in their path for the ability's duration.

A winsome smile, genial words, and the merciless hoarfrost that lies beneath... These are all Kaeya's weapons.

passive.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
passive.descriptionRaw: Every hit with <color=#FFD780FF>Frostgnaw</color> regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.
passive.description: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

passive.name: Glacial Heart
passive.descriptionRaw: Opponents <color=#99FFFFFF>Frozen</color> by <color=#FFD780FF>Frostgnaw</color> will drop additional Elemental Particles.\nFrostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.
passive.description:
Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles.
Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

passive.name: Hidden Strength
passive.descriptionRaw: Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.\nNot stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
passive.description:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

levels.name: Excellent Blood
levels.descriptionRaw: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> is increased by 15%.
levels.description: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

levels.name: Never-Ending Performance
levels.descriptionRaw: While <color=#FFD780FF>Glacial Waltz</color> is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.
levels.description: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

levels.name: Dance of Frost
levels.descriptionRaw: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Frostgnaw</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
levels.description:
Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Frozen Kiss
levels.descriptionRaw:
Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%:
Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s.
This shield absorbs <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo DMG</color> with 250% efficiency.
Can only occur once every 60s.

levels.name: Glacial Whirlwind
